newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline softens as customers remain elusive.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline softens as customers remain elusive.

text.p: NWE gasoline weakened on Wednesday on sickly crude prics, healthy supply and elusive buyers, traders said.
Eurograde barges were done at $197, $196 and then $198 in that order throughout the day.

Traders attributed the weaker prices to high supplies in the ARA region and lack of demand. The continued waning in crude prices was also seen pressuring prices -- May IPE Brent was down 29 cents at $18.82 a barrel at 1745 GMT.
Some said that the fine weather seen in Europe over the last few days could see an increase in consumption, but others said high inventories would cap the market for the time being.
Swaps remained in contango with April paper assessed at $199/$200 fob ARA, while May was pegged around the $201/$202.
On the cargo front, a Eurograde cargo was heard offered into Hamburg at around $205-$206, bids were heard around $204 cif NWE.
Traders said the fact a cargo was being offered into the region was an indication that arbitrage opportunities to the United States were closed.
